title: BelowConfinementFloor payload
description: The requested confinement is below the daemon's floor; the run was not submitted.

sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.title: ConfinementLevel
sdc.daemon.ConfinementLevel.description: How strongly a run is sandboxed, weakest first: the runtime's names. local is not confined; linux is. oci and pod are the runtime's planned levels and are not in the set until it offers them. The default of a submit is linux (the handler fills it); the daemon's default floor is linux; local must be asked for by name and is refused under a linux floor.

sdc.daemon.RunId.title: RunId
sdc.daemon.RunId.description: The id of a run. The daemon mints it (a UUID, version 7) in the HTTP handler and returns it in the answer to the submit; the handler fills the `run_id` input of SubmitRun and a client never chooses it. The state directory of the run is named after it. A run id that is already taken cannot occur, because the daemon mints it; the specification has no refusal for it.
